name: read_file
description: Reads the contents of a file. Optionally, can read a specific range of lines.

file_path.description: Path to the file to read.

name: read_multiple_files
description: Reads the contents of multiple files. Optionally, can read a specific range of lines for all files.

file_paths.description: List of paths to the files to read.

name: list_files
description: Lists all files in a specified path.

path.description: The directory path to list files from. Defaults to '.'.

recursive.description: Whether to list files recursively. Defaults to False.

name: list_directories
description: Lists all directories in a specified path.

path.description: The directory path to list directories from. Defaults to '.'.

recursive.description: Whether to list directories recursively. Defaults to False.

name: list_files_and_directories
description: Lists all files and directories in a specified path.

path.description: The directory path to list files and directories from. Defaults to '.'.

recursive.description: Whether to list recursively. Defaults to False.

name: find_files
description: Finds files matching a glob pattern in a specified path.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to search for (e.g., '*.py').

path.description: The directory path to search in. Defaults to '.'.

name: get_file_info
description: Gets metadata information about a file, such as size, created time, and modified time.

file_path.description: Path to the file to get information about.

name: get_file_outline
description: Gets an outline of classes and functions for a specified file.

file_path.description: Path to the file to outline.

name: get_multiple_files_outline
description: Gets an outline of classes and functions for multiple files.

file_paths.description: List of paths to the files to outline.

name: search_in_files
description: Searches for a text pattern inside files using ripgrep.

pattern.description: The regex or text pattern to search for.

path.description: The file or directory path to search in. Defaults to '.'.

before_context.description: Number of lines of before-context to show. Defaults to 0.

after_context.description: Number of lines of after-context to show. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Whether to enable multiline matching. Defaults to False.

name: search_multiple_patterns
description: Searches for multiple text patterns inside files using ripgrep.

patterns.description: List of regex or text patterns to search for.

path.description: The file or directory path to search in. Defaults to '.'.

before_context.description: Number of lines of before-context to show. Defaults to 0.

after_context.description: Number of lines of after-context to show. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Whether to enable multiline matching. Defaults to False.

name: write_file
description: Writes content to a file. Creates the file if it does not exist, or replaces its existing contents.

file_path.description: Path to the file to write.

content.description: The complete content to write to the file.

name: append_to_file
description: Appends content to the end of an existing file. Creates the file if it does not exist.

file_path.description: Path to the file to append to.

content.description: Content to append to the end of the file.

name: create_file
description: Creates a new file with the specified content. Fails if the file already exists.

file_path.description: Path to the new file to create.

content.description: Initial content of the new file.

name: replace_in_file
description: Replaces a specific piece of text in a file with new text.

file_path.description: Path to the file to modify.

old_text.description: The exact text to find in the file.

new_text.description: The text that will replace the matched text.

replace_all.description: Whether to replace all occurrences. Defaults to false.

name: write_multiple_files
description: Writes content to multiple files. Creates files if they do not exist or replaces their existing contents.

files.description: Mapping of file paths to the complete content that should be written to each file.

name: replace_in_multiple_files
description: Replaces specific text in multiple files.

file_paths.description: List of paths to the files to modify.

old_text.description: The exact text to find in the files.

new_text.description: The text that will replace the matched text.

replace_all.description: Whether to replace all occurrences in each file. Defaults to false.
